spec.after: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.section-foundation'); const ps = {}; for (const el of [s, ...s.querySelectorAll('*')].slice(0, 30)) for (const p of ['::before', '::after']) { const c = getComputedStyle(el, p); if (c.content && c.content !== 'none') ps[(el.className || el.tagName) + p] = { bdf: c.backdropFilter || c.webkitBackdropFilter, op: c.opacity, bg: c.backgroundColor, bgi: c.backgroundImage.slice(0, 120), pos: c.position, inset: [c.top, c.bottom, c.height].join(' '), mask: (c.maskImage || c.webkitMaskImage || '').slice(0, 120), z: c.zIndex }; } return { foundationStyle: s.getAttribute('style'), pseudo: ps }; })()
